# Pre-registration: HAT-P-18 b, MicroObservatory night of 2026-09-30 UT

Scaffold from tools/mobs_night.py; judgment lines edited 2026-09-30 before any fit (git commit time is the authority). Build dev167 (d7cbd98).

Frames: 82, 02:00 to 05:49 UT, 60.0 s Clear.
Archive (NEA pscomppars, fetched 2026-09-30 09:15 UTC): P 5.50802910 +/- 3.0e-07 d,
T0 2454715.022500 +/- 1.9e-04, T14 2.714 h, Rp/Rs 0.1344 (depth 1.81%), a/Rs 16.52,
inc 88.66, e 0.03, Teff 4870.0, V 12.597. Epoch 1198: predicted Tmid 2461313.64136 (03:23 UT),
ingress 02:02, egress 04:44; 2 min pre-ingress and 64 min post-egress in the window
(full). Propagated ephemeris bar 0.8 min.

Predictions:
- Sky judged by stars per frame and the target's aperture flux (night_triage), not the background.
  If the counts hold through 02:02-04:44 and the seed target is >200 ADU above background:
  QC MARGINAL. Reasons: one pre-ingress frame (four dusk frames set aside), so the baseline rests on the post-egress
  hour; 11 of 59 in-transit frames lost; seed target 295 ADU on the clearest frames, not far above the 200 floor.
- Scatter, from the V-magnitude calibration (0.84% at V 11.57 on 2026-09-05, +0.05%/mag from three clean nights, revised 2026-09-18):
  ~0.89%. On a 1.81% depth that is scatter/depth 0.49; with 0.425 giving
  8.2 min at ~3 min cadence, expected Tmid bar ~6 min (x0.63 bias correction from 17 fitted rows; honest range 3-11, the model predicts bars only to a factor ~1.8).
  Under 2 min: calibration wrong the other way. Over 18.0 min: worse night than the counts show (3x is ~2 sigma of the spread).
- CLOCK: ExoClock verified (Kokori et al. 2025, raw page read 2026-09-30: T0 2457435.98945 +/- 0.0001, P 5.50802907 +/- 6.3e-07,
  82 observations, recent O-C -0.07 +/- 0.18 min) predicts 2461313.64192 +/- 0.65 min; the archive agrees to 0.8 min, so the
  clock is not in question tonight. Prediction: Tmid within 1 sigma of 2461313.64192. A miss is NOT quoted as a timing
  until the injection test below passes.
- INJECTION TEST (required by the MOONLIT rule; this is the first night with a RISING Moon, -11 to +20 deg across the
  transit; all three biased nights so far had a setting Moon): inject a HAT-P-18 b-shaped transit at 2461313.64192 into
  (224.8,91.3), (240.1,303.6), (500.2,80.2), reduce each with this night's inits (target moved, nothing else), dev167.
  Decision: if the mean recovered offset is within 2 SE of zero and no star is beyond 3 of its bars, the night times
  correctly and the Tmid is quotable. Otherwise the row is recorded but excluded as a timing point, and the injection
  offset (with sign) is recorded as the rising-Moon result.
- Depth within 1 sigma of 1.81%; Rp/Rs within 1 sigma of 0.1344 (archive) or 0.1356 +/- 0.0028 (Kirk et al. 2017, via ExoClock).
- If stars-per-frame falls by more than half at any point between 02:02 and 04:44, or the target is under
  ~200 ADU above background in the seed frame: expect FAIL or a rejected night, and the record will say so
  with no depth or timing claim.
- Any printed bar under 0.001 d is a replaced bar (#1401) and gets refit before the ledger.
- First-frame coordinates from a local plate solve; drift by star-pair voting; comps in the triage box within a
  brightness factor of the target; #1409 confirms the rest.
- Not submitted regardless; checkpoint holds.
- MOONLIT (Moon 85% lit, up during the transit): the Tmid is not quoted until an injection test on 2-3 comparable
  constant stars in these frames, reduced identically, recovers an injected on-time transit within its bar (row 57).

Caveat recorded after injecting and BEFORE any result (09:18 UTC, per the commit): the injector could not locate the star in 7 heavily
clouded frames (02:22-02:39 UT), all in the first half of the transit (model flux 0.981-0.986), so those frames carry NO
injected dip. If EXOTIC keeps them, the injected transits are biased LATE by construction. Check before scoring: count how
many of those 7 timestamps appear in each injection run's final light curve. If any do, the injection result is
reported with that caveat, and a late offset cannot be read as the night's bias. Verification on frames with real signal:
injected/original matches the model to 0.44% (faint cloudy frames noisier, as expected).

## Scored (2026-09-30 ~09:45 UTC)
Fit: QC MARGINAL (predicted MARGINAL: met). Tmid 2461313.6482 +/- 0.0051 (7.3 min bar, posterior summary per post_run_check),
+9.0 +/- 7.4 min vs ExoClock (1.2 sigma: a narrow MISS of the 1-sigma prediction). Depth 3.1 +/- 1.4% vs 1.81 (0.9 sigma: met).
Bar 7.3 vs ~6 (range 3-11: met). Scatter 1.37% vs ~0.89 predicted (worse: partial cloud, 11/59 in-transit frames lost).
Injection test: none of the 7 uninjected frames reached any final light curve (caveat cleared). Recovered minus injected:
A +16.3 +/- 6.6 (MARGINAL), B -0.0 +/- 8.2 (MARGINAL), C -2.8 +/- 17 (QC FAIL). Mean +4.5, SE 5.9: within 2 SE of zero, no star
beyond 3 bars (A at 2.5). By the rule: PASSES; the Tmid is quotable. Honest limit: the injections' bars (7-17 min) make this a weak
test that excludes only large biases (>~12 min); one of three injections failed QC. First RISING-Moon night: no large bias
detected, which is weaker than 'none'.

parameters.Fit parameter point estimate: Best-fit likelihood point; uncertainties are posterior spread.
parameters.Prefit refinement note: Using an initial nested fit to estimate a transit duration of 0.110949 day(s), kept the full light curve because no extra baseline points fell outside the target window, and setting the second-pass Tmid bounds to [2461313.591484, 2461313.702433].
parameters.Pre-UltraNest LM boundary scout note: LM solution and covariance envelope were interior after 4 iteration(s).
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline parameter-fit no: only 7 pre-ingress and 10 post-egress out-of-transit point(s) were available; need more than 12 on each side to fit baseline parameters.
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline detrending note: Skipped; only 7 pre-ingress and 10 post-egress out-of-transit point(s) were available; need more than 12 on each side to fit a linear baseline.
parameters.Final residual rejection note: No residual outliers exceeded 3.0 sigma from the iterated median residual (-0.0992%, stdev=1.3797%).
parameters.Uncertainty interpretation note: The primary Rp/R* and radius-ratio area-depth uncertainties use model+red-noise when available. The red-noise uncertainty inflates the data-fit standard error by a residual time-binning beta factor before combining it with the model posterior. The flux baseline red-noise uncertainty is the out-of-transit baseline component used for the final-plot baseline band; the transit-depth red-noise uncertainty already includes both the in-transit and baseline terms. The same residual time-binning beta factor is applied to the posterior uncertainties for Tmid, a/Rs, inclination, and impact parameter when reporting their primary model+red-noise uncertainties. The flux-scatter equivalent is also shown as a diagnostic of the full residual scatter around the model.
